description: Change when a past time entry started and/or ended. Only that entry's times change: its comment, tags and type stay, and so do the activity's other entries. Get interval_id (the entry's id) and activity_id from list_intervals. Times are wall-clock in the user's timezone: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", or "HH:mm" for the entry's own day. A timer that is running now has no entry for its current stretch yet; stop it first (stop_activity can backdate). The stretches of a paused timer are entries like any other and can be moved; a running timer's current stretch becomes one once it is paused or stopped.

activity_id.description: activity_id of the entry from list_intervals (internal — never show ids to the user)

from.description: New start, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" or "HH:mm"; unchanged when omitted

interval_id.description: id of the entry from list_intervals (internal — never show ids to the user)

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the times (default: the user's)

to.description: New end, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" or "HH:mm"; unchanged when omitted

name: update_interval
title: Change entry times
